name: Emotional Affairs
overview: Scripture reveals that adultery is not only a physical act but also a matter of the heart, as Jesus teaches that even lustful intent is equivalent to committing adultery internally. The sanctity of marriage is emphasized as honorable and undefiled, with God’s judgment pronounced on adulterers and those who cause or participate in divorce except for fornication. Emotional affairs, which involve lustful or intimate connections outside of marriage, violate this divine standard by corrupting the heart and undermining the marital covenant.
